scope: Read-only Florida holiday 2026 TicketSmarter discovery; no repository or database mutations, no tracked URLs followed, no checkout or purchase.

existingTicketSmarterOffers: orlando-theater-ticketsmarter (Dr Phillips Walt Disney Theater browse destination)
coverageRead.integration: Existing server-only CJ partner; curated offer IDs resolve to registry destinations and are wrapped server-side. TicketSmarter host allowlist and requireTracking already exist. No new integration, tracking creative, commission rate, or arbitrary request destination is needed.
coverageRead.implementationCaution: Candidate destinations below are direct untracked merchant event URLs. Add only curated IDs through the existing server-side mechanism; do not expose or probe generated affiliate redirects. No implementation performed.

availabilityCaveat: Web extraction of TicketSmarter event pages often includes both a No Tickets Found notification form and positive inventory/count/price text. These establish real matching event listings and merchant-claimed inventory, but do not verify active selectable seats or successful checkout. None of the candidates is certified actively purchasable. Counts/prices are transient evidence, not suggested published promises. Use See resale tickets / Check resale availability, never official tickets, guaranteed availability, or fixed prices.

recommendedNextStep: Five strongest additions have official show/run evidence plus exact merchant event URLs. Before asserting purchasability or launching Book CTAs, independently inspect selectable inventory through direct untracked merchant pages. If that cannot be established, use a clearly labeled resale listing CTA and retain official organizer ticket option. Do not advertise static merchant inventory counts or prices.
